plain: Scientists found a rock from Mars in Antarctica that may hold traces of ancient bacteria. Jesse Michels says they found it in 1984 and gave it the code name ALH84001. If those traces are fossils, they would be signs of past life on another planet. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source. On another episode he recalls that in the 1990s President Bill Clinton made a speech about the meteorite. A researcher named John Brandenburg, who argues that Mars once had life, also talks about it. He confirms that ALH84001 was found in Antarctica but places the find in the 1990s, not 1984. The two tellers agree on the rock and where it was found, and both bring it up as a piece of evidence for life on Mars.
